CVE-2026-6383 affects KubeVirt RBAC resources for the kubevirt.io:edit role. virt-exportproxy ships only the virt-exportproxy binary and SBOM metadata; it does not ship KubeVirt operator manifests, ClusterRoles, or the RBAC generator code that grants VNC and screenshot subresource access.
